svg.text: FROM PROMPT TO PARLOR · ~60 MIN, FIRST DEPLOY IN 15
How it actually went
v1 ships · ~15 min
One tap swaps the whole site to a dessert palette via CSS variables,
with sprinkles falling from the top. Deployed.
Small passes
Click-burst mini-sprinkles, a 🍦 browser-tab title and cone favicon, and a
hidden brain-freeze blizzard on a fast triple-toggle.
Textures
A waffle-cone footer, whipped-cream drips down the top of the screen,
and a neapolitan wash behind the page.
Pivot · the gyroscope
Mobile tilt started snappy and clamped; reworked it into a smooth,
continuous gravity angle. Flip the phone and the sprinkles fall upward.
The toggle · 4 rounds
Bare cone → progressive disclosure → glossy cone-in-knob → a persistent
both-states slider that flips on AND off from any page.
Shipped 🍦
Persists across reloads with no flash; every toggle and browser tab stays
in sync. Live on mitchleonard.com.
The 15-minute job that the fun, unnecessary parts stretched into an hour — on purpose.
